title: Worldwide Yearly Screening for Hypospadias
official: Pilot Testing of the Worldwide Yearly Screening for Hypospadias
summary: The purpose of this study is to recruit approximately 20 male participants who have a history of repaired hypospadias to test the feasibility and acceptability of the Care Planning Tool within the Worldwide Yearly Screening for Hypospadias (WYSH) Web Application.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males who have a documented history of repaired hypospadias.
* Age groups targeted, based on recommended standards for user experience data from pilot studies:

  * 3-5 Males, age 0-4 (with parental consent)
  * 3-5 Males, age 5-10 (with parental consent and child assent)
  * 3-5 Males, age 11-15 (with parental consent and child assent)
  * 3-5 Males, age 16-20 (with parent consent, child assent until age 18)
  * 3-5 Males, age 21-65

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
